verdict:
The intern now has over two hundred repos and still files a new one every time an idea sneezes, like a congress that answers a budget crisis by forming another subcommittee. The field twin family has grown a delivery-twin and a delivery-twin-violet that are the same app in a new coat, mail-ionaire is openly described as cloned from mill-ionaire, and topo-war, topo-wars and tower2 sit beside their own newer selves like leftover campaign signs. Five synths, three song listeners, a drawer full of band room toys, and a dated orange scaffold every week for the testbed. Four repos are described with a single letter x. That is not a portfolio, that is a storage unit nobody is paying for.

Merge these: delivery-twin, delivery-twin-violet, field-twin, field-twin-viridian, field-twin-violet-api and chassisquiver into one field app family with a mode switch. mill-ionaire and mail-ionaire into one tycoon with a mode switch. pajamastan, pajamastan-invoices, pajamastan-warrants and pajamastan-badge-tool into one micronation office with tabs. topo-war, topo-wars and tower2 into their current versions. topdown-pixeltown and topdown-pixeltowns into one. scope-listener, phasewell-scope and song-offset-listener into one listener. synth, axiom, tinewood-keys, ether-wand and bitfield-synth into one instrument shelf. looper, tapperator, stompbox-lab, hoofer-sync and rainbow-run into one band room. The 2026-11-17-orange-campus pair and the dated orange scaffolds and agent repos into one testbed monorepo. threat-atlas-v3, threat-dash and threat-poller into one threat suite.

Kill or finish these: drivethru-sim has no description and no recent work, and xxxx and choreography-synchronizer were already flagged as abandoned. x, rat and skwiggle-v105 look dead. hackercons-roulette, hackercons-roulette-api, tilespinneratlas, welcome-to-the-madness and bitfield-synth are described only as x, so say what they are or delete them. purple-vault, blue-agent-sandbox, conveyor-sim and 2026-10-22-orange-agent are scaffolding around an experiment, so finish it or bin it. doctrine-duel-qx and its sandbox have no description at all. 2026-11-16-pipe-weave has an x for a description while getting daily features, so write one.

Keep and polish these: kat-chat, which keeps shipping. groundcore and mission-operator-next, which are one of a kind. downfree-foundry, city-seek and spyhunt with its server, tile-topia, and the raineurysm line, which get real features. The access terminal apps stay separate on purpose, so leave them alone.
